about: Golden transcript: each step is ProtocolCore.step(state, event, time_ms, rng) for one party. Hex unless noted; mailbox bodies are the exact wire JSON. Regenerate with WHERE_WRITE_VECTORS=1 ./gradlew :shared:jvmTest --tests '*GoldenTranscriptWriter*'.

rng.definition: Per party. Draw i (from 0) of n bytes = HKDF-SHA-256(IKM = SHA-256(UTF-8 seed), salt = empty, info = UTF-8 "where-test-rng" || u64be(i), L = n). An X25519 key pair is one 32-byte draw as the private key (clamped by X25519) and its public key.
